objects.taxonomy_description: A small, flat, baked food item typically characterized by a rigid structure and browned surface.

diagnostic_checkpoints.Overall_Shape: The object exhibits a flattened, disc-like or irregular geometric form distinct from spherical fruits or elongated breads.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Surface_Texture: The surface appears dry, matte, and slightly porous or crumbly, lacking the gloss of glazed pastries or the smoothness of raw dough.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Coloration: The object displays uniform golden-brown to dark-brown hues indicative of baking, contrasting with the pale color of uncooked dough or the vibrant colors of fresh produce.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Material_and_Context: The item presents as a solid, rigid mass without visible layers, fillings, or soft deformability typical of cakes or sandwiches.

objects.taxonomy_description: Bowed stringed instrument with a curved wooden body approximately 35 cm long. Body has an hourglass shape with C-bouts (inward curves) on each side. Top plate (soundboard) is spruce with two f-shaped sound holes. Back plate is maple with a distinctive flame pattern. Four strings (G, D, A, E) run from a tailpiece at the base over a bridge to tuning pegs in the scroll. Neck extends from the body to a carved scroll at the top. Fingerboard is ebony (black). Varnish finish is amber, reddish-brown, or golden. Chin rest is attached at the lower left. Bow is a wooden stick with horsehair.
